story:
Ethan wore his bright red cape every Saturday morning because Saturday was superhero day.

One day, he raced to the tall oak tree in the backyard, where his secret base was hidden behind the three round bushes. He had built a cardboard rescue rocket, but one chunky wing had fallen off, and the whole thing looked crooked and sad. [emotion:QT/sad] [emotion:QT/sad] "I don't know how to fix it," Ethan said quietly, tracing the rough torn edge with his thumb.

His neighbor, Rosa, climbed through the gap in the fence. "Maybe we could fix it together," she said cheerfully, holding up a roll of thick brown tape. [emotion:QT/happy] While Rosa held the broken wing steady, Ethan pressed the tape along the jagged edge. Then they both smoothed it down carefully.

[emotion:QT/happy] "It's ready!" Rosa cheered.

After that, the rocket stood straight and strong, like a real superhero standing tall. Ethan felt a warm, round feeling in his chest — not just pride, but something even better. [emotion:QT/happy] Gratitude.

Ethan alone at his secret base behind three round bushes near a tall oak tree in the backyard, looking sadly at his crooked cardboard rocket with a fallen-off wing.

questions.question: What is the main message of this story about Ethan and his rescue rocket?
questions.correct_answer: Working together with a friend makes things better
wrong_answers: Rockets are too tricky to fix

questions.question: Where was Ethan's secret superhero base hidden in the backyard?
questions.correct_answer: Behind three round bushes near the tall oak tree
wrong_answers: Inside the garage behind a red truck
Under the porch next to the fence

questions.question: After Rosa held the broken wing steady, what did Ethan do to fix the rescue rocket?
questions.correct_answer: He pressed thick brown tape along the rough torn edge
wrong_answers: He built a brand new cardboard wing
He tied the chunky wing back with rope

questions.question: Why do you think Ethan felt something even better than pride when the rocket was fixed?
questions.correct_answer: Because Rosa helped him and he was grateful for her
wrong_answers: Because the rocket was now the biggest one ever
Because he fixed the whole thing by himself

questions.question: What do you think would have happened if Rosa had not climbed through the gap in the fence that day?
questions.correct_answer: Ethan's rocket would have stayed crooked and broken
wrong_answers: Ethan would have found three rolls of tape right away
The rocket would have flown away on its own

questions.question: Why was it a good idea for Ethan to let Rosa help him with the rocket?
questions.correct_answer: Asking a friend for help makes hard things possible.
wrong_answers: Letting someone else do the work means you don't have to try as hard.
Waiting patiently for a problem to fix itself is the best plan.

questions.question: What did Ethan and Rosa show us by what they did?
questions.correct_answer: Working together and taking turns gets the job done faster.
wrong_answers: Having the right tools and supplies is the most important part of any project.
Practicing a skill on your own first makes you better at working with others.

questions.question: What is one lesson from this story?
questions.correct_answer: Feeling grateful means noticing when someone's kindness changed everything.
wrong_answers: Feeling proud of your work means you did it all by yourself without any help.
Feeling happy after finishing a task means you are ready for a bigger challenge.

takeaways: Asking a friend for help makes hard things possible.
Working together and taking turns gets the job done faster.
Feeling grateful means noticing when someone's kindness changed everything.
